independent_review: All native six-join, distinct personal-view, unchanged gameplay-state, rejoin and host-restart actor witnesses passed.
Save deferral removed the saving overlay from reviewed German rejoin/restart captures, but the Library itself is still absent from those pixels. The English restart remains readable.
The last joining client was asked for screenshots immediately on its join tick. Native GUI objects alone do not prove that the joining client has rendered them.
The revised fixture requires a visible root and gives both actual clients120 ticks after the latest join before requesting GUI screenshots. This is a changed capture mechanism, not a rendering pass.
